review_protocol.comparison: Unmodified full 512x768 six-view PNGs against their matching reference grid, at the overview scale used in the comparison PDFs.
review_protocol.decision_unit: A label is present only when the failure is visibly apparent in at least two of six views; not_observed means no clear instance at this review scale, not proof of absence.
review_protocol.purple_cast: Visible pink, magenta, or lavender hue shift relative to the matching foreground reference; kept separate from the frozen Lab threshold.
review_protocol.repeated_texture: An unintended repeated material mark or texture within/between distinct object views; repeated reference tiles do not count.
review_protocol.fine_detail_loss: Reference surface detail or material variation is visibly smoothed away in at least two predicted views.
review_protocol.structure_damage: Visible object form, topology, or identity mismatch in at least two views.
review_protocol.limitations: Single-reviewer descriptive labels on a failure-enriched development set; no blinded rating or independent confirmation.
